metadata.title: Evidence Record: Shared DFT Anchors
metadata.deck: A projected saving, and what happened when we ran it. A frozen, artifact-backed analysis of 29 analyzable diffusion paths compares four separately evaluated sparse-anchor sets with their shared union.
metadata.evidenceStatus: Projected accounting, no new DFT. Internally reviewed (AI-assisted); not peer-reviewed.

summary.claim: On the locked Z1 panel’s 29 analyzable paths, sharing identical sparse-anchor image indices across four universal interatomic-potential guides reduces the projected DFT evaluation count from 558 to 154: 72.4% fewer DFT evaluations. The baseline is four separate runs, and on these short paths deduplication alone caps the saving at 73.1%.
summary.scope: Prediction-side accounting under the frozen sparse-anchor rule on one locked path panel, using four recorded model artifacts.
limitations: The shared union is a projected evaluation set; this analysis does not claim that the union has been evaluated by DFT.
The result does not establish accuracy parity or transfer to another panel, chemistry, engine, model set, or anchor rule.
Projected and realized campaign records remain separate and are not combined in this evidence record.
No dollar amount, wall-time conversion, annualization, or additional economic multiplier is inferred.
The realized July 2026 pilot failed its preregistered accuracy gate; its passing check is same-engine only and is summarized here, not combined with the projection.
summary.lead: Four model guides nominate sparse images on the same diffusion paths. Deduplicating identical within-path image indices reduces the locked projected reference-evaluation count from 558 to 154. The baseline is four separate runs.

findings.label: Finding
findings.text: 72.4% fewer DFT evaluations, projected. The frozen separate-model accounting contains 558 projected DFT evaluations; the shared union contains 154. The baseline is four separate runs.

findings.label: Ceiling
findings.text: The paths have 5–7 images, 167 in all, and the union covers 154 of them; deduplication alone caps the saving at 73.1%.

findings.label: Exclusion
findings.text: One panel path lacks a converged prediction profile in all four artifacts and is excluded rather than imputed.

findings.label: Boundary
findings.text: The result is prediction-side accounting, not an executed-DFT, accuracy, cost, or universal-transfer claim.

findings.label: Realized pilot
findings.text: In July 2026 the preregistered 40 meV gate against published VASP barriers failed (path 7: 118.8 meV). A same-engine check adopted after that failure passed (0.0–6.8 meV) with every image evaluated: Open (same-engine only). Error against the published references: 693.0–705.7 meV.

summary.verdictDetail: Supported as projected accounting only; not an accuracy result.
summary.verdictBody: The committed JSON record, input SHA-256 digests, analysis script, and separately locked figure support the 558-to-154 comparison on 29 analyzable paths. Missing model–path profiles remain explicit and no realized campaign denominator is substituted. The realized pilot did not show accuracy against published references.
summary.orientation: This record presents the locked figure and table first, then the selection rule, exclusions, published literature, and audit trail. The full account of the pilot is “What happened when we ran it” on the canonical article.

rows.basis: Four model-specific anchor sets, counted separately
Within-path union of identical image indices

methodology.description: Recorded predicted image-energy profiles select sparse anchor indices under a frozen rule. The analysis compares the sum of available model-specific sets with the cardinality of their within-path union and runs no new DFT.
steps: Read the locked 30-path Z1 panel and the four recorded model artifacts identified by SHA-256 in the analysis JSON.
For each available model–path profile, select endpoints, the predicted minimum, and a clamped neighborhood around the predicted maximum under the frozen rule.
Count all available model-specific sets for the separate-model basis.
Deduplicate equal image indices within each path for the shared-union basis.
Exclude the one path with no converged profile in any model and preserve all other missing profiles without imputation.
Validate the released data pack and the figure against their SHA-256 manifests.
methodology.unitOfAnalysis: Model–path sparse-anchor set and within-path union of image indices
methodology.versioning: LS-PP-2026-006 version 1.1.0, 2026-11-12 (version 1.0.0: 2026-08-03). Figure input and generated PDF checksums are in the evidence-record manifests.
methodology.limitations: One locked panel, four recorded universal interatomic-potential guides, one sparse-anchor rule, prediction-side accounting only. No accuracy, realized execution, dollar, wall-time, energy, emissions, or transfer claim is made.
inputs: Locked Z1 path panel with the digest recorded in the analysis JSON
Four recorded model campaign artifacts with digests recorded in the analysis JSON
transformations: Sparse-anchor selection under the frozen extrema rule
Within-path set union of identical image indices
No imputation of missing model–path profiles
validation: Input SHA-256 digests in the machine-readable record
Byte-verifiable JSON sidecar and complete data-pack manifest
Figure SHA-256 lock in this manifest
reproduction: Run sha256sum -c MANIFEST.sha256 in the released data pack
Run union_anchor_economics.py against the recorded local artifacts with the pinned recorded-at timestamp
Compare the output JSON with z1-union-anchor-economics.json.sha256
